N1.definition: Public information (NC) or information intended for all employees (C1).
confier: Open source code, documentation and published content
Monitoring and research on public sources
Internal notes and documents intended for all employees (C1)
jamais: Customer or personal data (C3, level N3)
N1.garanties: Executed in the European Union or outside the EU depending on the model: each model shows its execution region.

N2.definition: Restricted internal information (C2), without sensitive personal data.
jamais: Customer or personal data (C3, level N3)
Contracts, secrets and data under NDA (C3, level N3)
N2.garanties: Hosts committed to neither retaining the data nor using it for training, preferably in the European Union.

N3.definition: Customer, personal, HR, financial and contractual data, secrets, data under NDA or from the public sector.
confier: Data under NDA or from the public sector
jamais: Government classified information (Diffusion Restreinte and above)
Data that a contract forbids entrusting to a third party
N3.garanties: Models hosted in France by OVHcloud, under a data processing agreement; eventually by LINAGORA or a sovereign host.

EXP.definition: Recent models in beta, to try with public data only.
confier: Tests and prototypes on public data
EXP.garanties: Beta service without guarantee: a model may change or be withdrawn without notice. Dedicated key, limited to experimental models.

abonnements.introduction: These offers are taken out individually with their supplier. Request one for your team: once your request is approved, you subscribe yourself, then declare the subscription in the portal.
abonnements.reserve: A subscription is granted only after an enhanced review and on detailed justification: it is not the solution we favour by default. For most uses, request an API key for the gateway models instead.

apiDecision.titre: A decision API, not a chat model
apiDecision.explication: This model is a decision API (“System One”): it does not chat. The last message holds a JSON request: “state” describes the situation, “questions” lists the expected decisions, each with its type and instructions. The response is an “answers” JSON object, with one answer per question.

apiImage.explication: This model creates an image from your description. Call it like a chat model, asking for an image as output ("modalities"): the image comes back base64-encoded in the response, ready to save.

apiEmbeddings.explication: This model does not chat: it turns each text into a vector of numbers, for semantic search, RAG, document clustering or duplicate detection. Call it through /v1/embeddings, with one or more texts. Vectors from two different models cannot be compared: switching models means recomputing every vector.

opencode.intro: OpenCode is an open source coding assistant that works in the terminal. This page builds its configuration from your issued keys: each key becomes an entry, with its chat models. Your key never goes through the portal: the commands ask you for it in the terminal, without displaying it.
opencode.indisponible: The gateway is not responding: the configuration cannot be built for now. Please try again in a few moments.

raisonsModele.non_declare: no longer declared by the gateway

opencode.aucuneChoisie: Tick at least one key to get the configuration.
opencode.couts: OpenCode shows costs in dollars: the configuration converts the gateway's prices at LINAGORA's internal rate.
opencode.commandesExplication: Run these commands in a terminal: they ask you for each key, without displaying it, then restart OpenCode.
opencode.verification: Then check that your models are recognized:

etapeInstaller.terminal: The terminal is the window where you type commands. To open it: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Alt</kbd> + <kbd>T</kbd>.
etapeInstaller.coller: To run a command from this page: copy it, paste it into the terminal with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>V</kbd>, then press <kbd>Enter</kbd>.
etapeInstaller.installer: Install OpenCode with its official script, then close the terminal and open a new one:
etapeInstaller.verifier: Check the installed version: it should display opencode v2.x.

etapeCles.rappel: The code of the project opened in OpenCode is sent to the model: choose a key whose confidentiality level covers the classification of your repository.

niveaux.N1: open source code, or code shared with all employees
niveaux.N3: secret code or code of a customer

etapeConfiguration.ouvrir: Open the OpenCode configuration file in the gedit text editor:
etapeConfiguration.gedit: gedit does not open? Install it with sudo apt install gedit.
etapeConfiguration.coller: Copy the configuration below, paste it into gedit with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>V</kbd>, save with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>S</kbd>, then close gedit.
etapeConfiguration.existant: The file already contains text? Do not erase it: only add the entries of the providers block, and the model and update lines if any, keeping braces and commas valid.

etapeUtiliser.lancer: Start OpenCode in your project: go to its folder, then type opencode. OpenCode only works in that folder.
etapeUtiliser.choisir: To pick a model: type /models then Enter, type LINAGORA to filter, choose with the arrow keys, then Enter.
etapeUtiliser.favori: To add a model to your favorites: in that list, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>F</kbd> pins it at the top.
etapeUtiliser.changer: To switch models quickly: <kbd>F2</kbd> moves to the next recent model, <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>F2</kbd> to the previous one.

retrait.renouvellement: It renews your key {ancienAlias}, which the gateway now refuses.
retrait.alerte: If you did not pick up this key yourself, tell the portal administrators right away.

remplacement.corps: The integration {integration} replaced your API key {alias} on your behalf with a new key, {nouvelAlias}: the gateway now refuses the old one, and the new one was only shown in the integration.
remplacement.alerte: If you did not replace this key yourself, tell the portal administrators right away.

revocation.corps: The integration {integration} revoked your API key {alias} on your behalf: the gateway now refuses it.
revocation.alerte: If you did not revoke this key yourself, tell the portal administrators right away.

budget.corps: {plafond, select, oui {{auteur} set the budget of the team {equipe} to {budget}. Once it is reached, the gateway refuses the team's keys until the next period.} other {{auteur} removed the budget cap of the team {equipe}: its spend is no longer limited.}}

responsableDesigne.corps: {auteur} designated {responsable} as a manager of the team {equipe}.

responsableRetire.sujet: Manager role withdrawn in the team {equipe}: {responsable}
responsableRetire.corps: {auteur} removed the manager role of {responsable} for the team {equipe}.

decision.corps: {auteur} {decision, select, approuvee {approved the API key request of {demandeur}} refusee {refused the request of {demandeur}} complement {asked {demandeur} to complete their request} adhesion {accepted the access request of {demandeur}} abonnement {approved the subscription request of {demandeur}} other {processed the request of {demandeur}}}{sansAccord, select, oui {, without waiting for a team manager's agreement} other {}}.

cle.sujet: Action on a key of the team {equipe}: {alias}
cle.corps: {auteur} {action, select, revocation {revoked} blocage {blocked} other {unblocked}} the key {alias} of {titulaire}.

resiliationDemandee.corps: {auteur} requested the cancellation of the subscription {offre} of {titulaire}.

alerteBudget.corps: The team {equipe} has spent {depense, number, ::currency/EUR} of its budget of {budget, number, ::currency/EUR}{fin, select, aucune {} other { for the period ending on {fin}}}.
alerteBudget.suite: {niveau, select, atteint {The gateway refuses its keys} other {Once this budget is reached, the gateway will refuse its keys}} {fin, select, aucune {until it is raised} other {until that date}}.

ajoutMembre.sujet: You are a member of the team {equipe}
ajoutMembre.corps: {auteur} added you to the team {equipe}: you can request an API key there.

sortieMembre.sujet: You are no longer a member of the team {equipe}

designationResponsable.sujet: You are a manager of the team {equipe}
designationResponsable.corps: {auteur} designated you as a manager of the team {equipe}: you approve its access and key requests (except your own), and manage its members and keys from the portal's administration.

integration.alerte: This email is sent to every administrator of the portal whenever an integration changes. If this change surprises you, check it in the “Integrations” tab and disable the integration at the slightest doubt.

creee.corps: {auteur} declared the integration {nom} ({id}), disabled until an administrator enables it:

cleAjoutee.sujet: Public key added to the integration {nom}
cleAjoutee.corps: {auteur} added a public key to the integration {nom} ({id}); compare its fingerprint with the one given by the integrator:

cleHorsService.sujet: Public key retired for the integration {nom}
cleHorsService.corps: {auteur} retired a public key of the integration {nom} ({id}); tokens it signs are now rejected:

activee.corps: {auteur} enabled the integration {nom} ({id}): it can call the portal API for any employee, within its scope ({perimetres}).

desactivee.corps: {auteur} disabled the integration {nom} ({id}): its calls to the portal API are rejected.

validation.valideePar: Your request will be approved by: {valideurs}.
validation.valideeParAdmins: Your request will be approved by the administrators.
validation.accordPuisApprobation: Your request will first need the agreement of: {responsables}, then an administrator's approval.
validation.approbationParAdmins: Your request will be approved by an administrator.

demandeAbonnement.engagement: I commit not to entrust this subscription with any data above: {niveau}.
demandeAbonnement.offreIntrouvable: This offer is no longer available.
demandeAbonnement.completerRenouvellement: Renewal of your subscription attached to the {equipe} team: the offer and the team remain those of the subscription.
demandeAbonnement.completerChangement: Plan change of your subscription attached to the {equipe} team: the team remains that of the subscription.
demandeAbonnement.renouvellementImpossible: This subscription cannot be renewed now: the renewal of a subscription that is not cancelled can be requested from one month before its expiry.
demandeAbonnement.equipeEtEcheance: Attached to the {equipe} team, expires on {date}.
demandeAbonnement.aideRenouvellement: Once approved, the renewal extends the expiry by the granted period, from the current expiry, without a new declaration; if refused, it counts as a cancellation request for the subscription.
demandeAbonnement.abonnementIntrouvable: This subscription cannot be found or is cancelled.
demandeAbonnement.aucuneAutreOffre: No other offer from the supplier of your subscription {offre} is available.
demandeAbonnement.abonnementRemplace: Replaced subscription: {offre}, attached to the {equipe} team.
demandeAbonnement.aideChangement: Once the request is approved, take out the new offer with the supplier, then declare it in “My subscriptions”: the replaced subscription will be cancelled as of the declared subscription date.
demandeAbonnement.engagementOffreChoisie: I commit not to entrust this subscription with any data above the maximum level of the chosen offer.

mesAbonnements.introduction: Your individual subscriptions to AI suppliers' offers. Once the subscription is taken out with the supplier, declare your approved request here.

resiliation.aide: First cancel the subscription with {fournisseur}, then declare its date here: no charge counts from that day.

correction.aide: Price increase, exchange rate: the correction applies from the next charge.

erreurs.jeton_invalide: {reason, select, absent {Missing integration token: every call carries the header Authorization: Bearer followed by the token.} illisible {Unreadable integration token: a signed JWT is expected.} integration_inconnue {Integration token rejected: unknown integration (iss).} cle_inconnue {Integration token rejected: unknown or retired key (kid).} algorithme {Integration token rejected: its algorithm is not the one of the registered key.} signature {Integration token rejected: invalid signature.} destinataire {Integration token rejected: unexpected audience (aud).} expire {Integration token expired.} futur {Integration token not valid yet: check the integration's clock.} duree {Integration token rejected: its validity exceeds five minutes.} revendication {Integration token rejected: claim {claim} missing or invalid.} other {Integration token rejected.}}
erreurs.integration_inactive: This integration is disabled: its calls are rejected.
erreurs.adresse_non_autorisee: The caller's IP address is not allowed for this integration.
erreurs.trop_de_requetes: Too many requests for this integration: retry after the delay given by Retry-After.
erreurs.hors_perimetre: This route is outside the integration's scope ({scope}).
erreurs.erreur_interne: An error occurred: try again later.
erreurs.identite_incoherente: Inconsistent identity: this uid is unknown to the portal and its email address already belongs to another employee. Check the identifier (sub) sent by the integration: it is the LDAP uid that LemonLDAP::NG gives to the portal.
erreurs.saisie_invalide: {reason, select, taille {Request body too large: 16 KiB at most.} json {Unreadable request body: a JSON object is expected.} other {Invalid input: check the fields {champs}.}}

documentationApi.introduction: The portal also lets requests be made through an API: an application declared by the administrators, an integration (Team Manager, for instance), can, on behalf of an employee, read their teams, the catalog, their requests and keys, and submit their key or team access requests. Requests are then approved in the portal, like any other.
documentationApi.guide: The <lien>integration guide</lien> explains how to declare an integration, create its key pair and sign its tokens. The API contract follows.
documentationApi.essai: To try a route: “Authorize”, paste a token signed by your integration, then “Try it out”. Calls leave from your browser and go through the checks of any API call: active integration, allowed IP address, rate limit and scope.
